speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider allowing Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation cardholders to receive subsidies for certain treatments at selected traditional Chinese medicine clinics approved by the Ministry.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Charitable TCM establishments with Institution of Public Character status also benefit from tax exemption and are eligible to receive tax deductible donations, which then enable them to provide affordable TCM services in the community.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Seniors who wish to seek TCM treatments can receive these affordable TCM services in such establishments in the community.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Many of the elderly whom I meet believe in the great benefits of acupuncture.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Will the Ministry at least consider allowing PG and MG cardholders to receive subsidies for acupuncture treatments referred by doctors to TCM clinics in the public hospitals.
